WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),1) AS gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH nl AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost, f.quantity, p.sku
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned, -r.quantity_returned, p.sku
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
),
mine AS (
    SELECT nl.store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS mine_net,
           SUM(CASE WHEN cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_cost_rows,
           SUM(CASE WHEN cost = 0 AND net_sales <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_cost_rows,
           SUM(CASE WHEN cost > ABS(net_sales)*1.5 AND net_sales>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_gt_net_rows,
           COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM nl
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = nl.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE nl.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND cs.region = 'South'
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.store_id, m.mine_net, c.ctl_net, ROUND(m.mine_net - c.ctl_net,2) AS gap, m.null_cost_rows, m.zero_cost_rows, m.cost_gt_net_rows, m.n
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctl c USING (store_id) ORDER BY 1

SELECT fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) AS start_d, MAX(calendar_date) AS end_d, COUNT(*) AS days, MIN(fiscal_week) AS w1, MAX(fiscal_week) AS w2
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_quarter=4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) DESC) AS rank, 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_quarter,
       cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost), 2) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10
